decisions.statement: The repository is the folder git is run in rather than an argument to git.
A command git could not run is answered as data rather than thrown.
A folder that is no folder is answered before any process is started.
A process is started in a group of its own.
The group is killed once the process ends.
A ceiling is stated in milliseconds and kills the group when the ceiling passes.
A run that passed its ceiling answers no code of its own.
The git that is run is the git the environment names.
A run the environment names no git for runs `git`.
The streams git wrote are answered trimmed.
The fields are spelled as the callers spell those fields rather than as the runner does.

definition: a git command run without a throw, and the code and both streams it answered
